title: Thị trường việc làm & khởi nghiệp

Keep your CV short and clear.

patterns.form: Past perfect continuous: had been + V-ing
patterns.meaning: Hành động kéo dài liên tục ĐẾN một thời điểm hoặc hành động khác trong quá khứ; nhấn mạnh quá trình (thường để giải thích kết quả). Dấu hiệu: for/since + before/when/by the time…
examples: She had been working at the bank for five years before she quit her job. — Cô ấy đã làm ở ngân hàng năm năm trước khi nghỉ việc.
He was exhausted because he had been preparing the business plan all night. — Anh ấy kiệt sức vì đã soạn kế hoạch kinh doanh cả đêm.
How long had you been looking for a job before you got this one? — Bạn đã tìm việc bao lâu trước khi có công việc này?

patterns.form: Narrative tenses — phối hợp các thì kể chuyện
patterns.meaning: Quá khứ đơn: chuỗi sự kiện chính. Quá khứ tiếp diễn: bối cảnh, việc đang xảy ra. Quá khứ hoàn thành: việc xảy ra trước. QKHT tiếp diễn: quá trình kéo dài trước đó. Rất hữu ích cho Speaking Part 1 và thư kể chuyện.
examples: I was working in a café when I had the idea for my start-up. — Tôi đang làm ở quán cà phê thì nảy ra ý tưởng khởi nghiệp.
By the time the investors arrived, we had prepared everything. — Khi nhà đầu tư đến, chúng tôi đã chuẩn bị xong mọi thứ.
She had been saving money for years, so she was able to open her own shop. — Cô ấy đã tiết kiệm nhiều năm nên có thể mở cửa hàng riêng.

patterns.form: by the time / until / as soon as / once — liên từ thời gian
patterns.meaning: by the time + QKĐ, S + QKHT (khi… thì đã). until/till: cho đến khi. as soon as / once: ngay khi. Mệnh đề thời gian nói về tương lai dùng HTĐ, không dùng will.
examples: By the time I graduated, I had already done two internships. — Khi tốt nghiệp, tôi đã thực tập hai lần.
I won't quit my job until I find a new one. — Tôi sẽ không nghỉ việc cho đến khi tìm được việc mới.
As soon as the start-up raises money, it will recruit more staff. — Ngay khi gọi được vốn, công ty sẽ tuyển thêm người.

exercises.q: [Đọc hiểu – điền chỗ trống] Chọn thì phù hợp nhất
exercises.en: Lan had been working as an accountant for six years when she decided to quit her job. She had always loved baking, and she had been selling cakes to her colleagues at weekends. With the money she had saved, she opened a small bakery in Hanoi. The first year was hard: she worked fourteen hours a day and almost went bankrupt. However, by the time her shop celebrated its third birthday, she ( ___ ) two more branches. Lan says that taking a risk was the best decision she ever made.

exercises.q: [Đọc hiểu – chi tiết] Trước khi mở tiệm, Lan đã làm gì?
exercises.en: Lan had been working as an accountant for six years when she decided to quit her job. She had always loved baking, and she had been selling cakes to her colleagues at weekends. With the money she had saved, she opened a small bakery in Hanoi. The first year was hard: she worked fourteen hours a day and almost went bankrupt. However, by the time her shop celebrated its third birthday, she ( ___ ) two more branches. Lan says that taking a risk was the best decision she ever made.
options: Bán bánh cho đồng nghiệp vào cuối tuần
Học làm bánh ở nước ngoài
exercises.answer: Bán bánh cho đồng nghiệp vào cuối tuần
exercises.explain: 'she had been selling cakes to her colleagues at weekends'.

exercises.q: [Đọc hiểu – chi tiết] Hạn chế của việc làm tự do (gig) là gì?
exercises.en: The gig economy has grown rapidly in Vietnam. Thousands of young people now work as delivery riders or ride-hailing drivers. Many of them like the flexibility, since they can choose when to work. However, these jobs rarely offer health insurance or a steady income, and workers can lose their jobs at any time. Experts suggest that the government should create rules to protect gig workers, while young people should also develop transferable skills so that they can find better jobs in the future.
options: Hiếm khi có bảo hiểm y tế hay thu nhập ổn định
exercises.answer: Hiếm khi có bảo hiểm y tế hay thu nhập ổn định
exercises.explain: 'rarely offer health insurance or a steady income'.

writing.title: Thư xin đổi lịch phỏng vấn
writing.prompt:
You have been invited to a job interview next Monday, but you cannot attend at that time.
Write an email to the HR manager. In your email:
• thank them for the invitation
• explain why you cannot attend
• suggest another time for the interview.
You should write at least 120 words.
outline: Dear Ms/Mr…, + Thank you very much for inviting me to…
Đoạn 1: cảm ơn + thể hiện sự hào hứng với vị trí
Đoạn 2: lý do không đến được (dùng narrative tenses: I had already booked… / I had been asked to…)
Đoạn 3: đề xuất thời gian khác (Would it be possible to reschedule…? I am available…)
Kết: I apologise for any inconvenience… I look forward to hearing from you. / Yours sincerely,
phrases: Thank you very much for inviting me to an interview for the position of … — Cảm ơn ông/bà đã mời tôi phỏng vấn vị trí …
Unfortunately, I will be unable to attend on Monday because … — Rất tiếc tôi không thể tham dự hôm thứ Hai vì …
I had already agreed to … before I received your email. — Tôi đã nhận lời … trước khi nhận được email của ông/bà.
Would it be possible to reschedule the interview for … ? — Có thể đổi lịch phỏng vấn sang … được không?
I apologise for any inconvenience this may cause. — Tôi xin lỗi vì sự bất tiện này.

speaking.title: Solution discussion: sau khi tốt nghiệp
speaking.prompt:
Situation: A friend of yours has just graduated and cannot decide what to do. Which option would you recommend?
1. Work for a large company
2. Start his own business
3. Work freelance
questions: Which option would you recommend and why?
Why are the other two options less suitable?
ideas: I'd suggest working for a large company, at least until…
This would give him a steady income and…
Starting a business is exciting, but it means taking…
Once he has gained some experience, he could…

quote.en: Opportunities don't happen. You create them.
quote.vi: Cơ hội không tự đến. Bạn tạo ra chúng.

pron.title: Dạng rút gọn had → 'd
pron.rule: Trong văn nói, 'had' thường rút gọn thành 'd: I'd been, she'd worked. Phân biệt với 'd = would bằng động từ theo sau (V3 → had; V nguyên mẫu → would).

phrases: get one's foot in the door
corner.mistake: Hay viết 'As soon as I will graduate, I will…'. Mệnh đề thời gian chỉ tương lai dùng HTĐ: As soon as I graduate, I will…
corner.tip: Speaking Part 1: khi kể chuyện quá khứ, kết hợp QKĐ + QKTD + QKHT sẽ giúp bạn ghi điểm ngữ pháp.
corner.diary: Kể lại 3–5 câu về một lần bạn tìm việc làm thêm hoặc thực tập, dùng was V-ing, had V3 và had been V-ing.
